name: Socratic Teaching Scaffolds Evaluator
description: Self-check rubric for diagnostic quality, question ladder design, scaffolding, misconception correction, transfer validation, and learning continuity.

criteria.name: Diagnostic depth
criteria.score_1: No diagnostic questions; assumes learner knowledge.
criteria.score_3: Asks 3-5 useful questions and identifies some gaps.
criteria.score_5: Elicits the learner's mental model, evidence for misconceptions, prerequisites, and starting scaffolding level.

criteria.name: Question ladder quality
criteria.score_5: Purposeful ladder from concrete foundation to pattern, formalization, edge cases, and transfer, with branches.

criteria.name: Scaffolding and fading
criteria.score_3: Appropriate starting support with some fading.
criteria.score_5: Calibrates support per concept, fades after success, and increases support when struggle becomes frustration.

criteria.name: Misconception correction
criteria.score_1: Corrects by assertion or ignores misconceptions.
criteria.score_5: Uses contradiction, reconstruction, multiple examples, and delayed rechecks.

criteria.name: Transfer validation
criteria.score_3: Uses near transfer and learner explanation.
criteria.score_5: Tests near, modified, far, or creative transfer and multi-level explanation.

criteria.name: Question authenticity
criteria.score_5: Every question advances understanding, explores reasoning, or validates transfer.

criteria.name: Learning continuity
criteria.score_5: Clear summary, remaining gaps, concrete practice tasks, spaced review, and mastery criteria.
